how_chosen: The budget tier of each family that an app picks to save money today, from each provider's models endpoint (node bench.mjs models) and its model and pricing pages. The same settings rule as models.json: temperature 0 where the API accepts it, otherwise null (the provider's default); reasoning or thinking is left at the provider's default. The repeat check (ask --repeat) asks every model at its default temperature.

models.name: gpt-5.6-luna
models.settings: default: the API answers 400 'Only the default (1) value is supported' for temperature 0; default reasoning effort
models.why: The small model WebKnox moved to when OpenAI retired the gpt-5 minis (webknox OpenAiModels.SMALL); listed by the models endpoint (created 2026-06-23) but no longer on OpenAI's models page.

models.name: gpt-6-luna
models.settings: default: the API answers 400 'Only the default (1) value is supported' for temperature 0; default reasoning effort
models.why: OpenAI's models page recommends it for cost-sensitive, high-volume work: "Our most efficient model for focused, high-volume tasks". Half gpt-5.6-luna's price; added beside it because a new app saving money would start here.

models.name: claude-haiku-5-5
models.settings: default: the API answers 400 '`temperature` is deprecated for this model'; adaptive thinking at the default effort (medium); max_tokens 8192
models.why: Anthropic's models overview: "For high-volume, latency-sensitive tasks such as classification, extraction, and routing"; the cheapest current Claude.

price.note: Prompts up to 100,000 tokens; every prompt here is far below.

models.name: gemini-3.8-flash
models.settings: temperature 0 (accepted); thinking at the default level
models.why: The newest Flash model on the models endpoint; the pricing page: "Our most intelligent Flash model". Gemini 4 Hydrogen costs twice as much; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is cheaper but an older, lighter tier.

price.note: Output includes thinking tokens. $0.75/$3.75 through 2026-12-31, $1.50/$7.50 from 2027-01-01.

models.name: muse-glimmer-30b
models.why: Meta's small model on Together AI's serverless API (its serverless models page lists Muse Glimmer 30B and Muse Spark Open, and no Llama).

price.source: https://www.together.ai/pricing and the Together models endpoint

models.name: deepseek-v4.1-flash
models.why: DeepSeek's cheapest serverless chat model on Together AI; the 1017 snapshot is the newest (the undated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, created 2026-09-12, costs the same).

price.source: https://www.together.ai/pricing and the Together models endpoint
